observations.detail: TEST-01 native Workspace showed the Host-approved Wave 2 fixture Asset count report. Adding it to the user's initially empty Dashboard created a local DRAFT revision 0 tile. Opening the tile executed the current Host report and displayed nine rows, matching the authenticated TEST-02 Host query.

TEST-01 native Dashboard sync changed DRAFT revision 0 to SYNCED revision 1. Closed the actual Ventio Client and reopened it from its installed Windows desktop shortcut. The same tile and SYNCED revision 1 survived. Opening it after restart again returned the current nine-row Host report.

limits: This verifies one approved report and one user's dashboard across a native process restart, not all filters, permission revocation, or empty/error states.
The corrected 17fa1b7 Client installation and final release artifact are still pending.
